scopeNote: Simple or extended lists of terms with a flat, usually non-hierarchical structure, organized alphabetically or by topic, and often including definitions.
An alphabetically ordered list of terms with meanings and usage.
A flat collection of terms without hierarchy or relationships.
An alphabetically ordered list of specialized terms with short definitions.
A collection of terms with the same or similar meaning under a preferred term.
A directory of entities or resources with metadata, unique identifiers, alternative names, and additional attributes.
A directory of geographic places with unique identifiers and metadata.
A directory of entities (e.g. persons, places, organizations) with standardized names and unique identifiers.
A hierarchical or flat structure that organizes concepts into categories or classes, supporting search and navigation through flexible keywords or standardized taxonomies.
A system combining subject headings into predefined term strings.
A system grouping terms into categories based on shared characteristics.
A system organizing terms into classes using notations (e.g. numbers or codes).
A system organizing terms in hierarchical relationships.
A complex, highly structured network in which nodes represent concepts and edges define relationships, varying in their level of formalization and types of relationships.
A system of terms with hierarchical, associative, and synonymous relationships.
A system connecting concepts as nodes through relationships.
A model of concepts with properties and logically defined relationships.
A structured network of entities (e.g. persons, places, organizations) with properties and relationships.
